stories.summary: OpenAI has secured $11 billion in fresh capital, the first tranche of a round that values the company at $1.25 trillion. The full round could swell to $20 billion. That OpenAI is already turning to wealthy private investors hints at a saturating AI capital mar
points: OpenAI has secured $11 billion in fresh capital, the first tranche of a round that values the company at $1.25 trillion.
The full round could swell to $20 billion.
That OpenAI is already turning to wealthy private investors hints at a saturating AI capital market and growing investor caution.

stories.title: AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms, new study finds
stories.originalTitle: AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms, new study finds
stories.summary: AI models can often spot problematic behavior by other AI agents in logs, according to a study by Anthropic researcher Andy Hall. GPT-5 found about 98 percent of reward-hacking cases, but the more exhaustively the search is tuned, the more false alarms pile up
points: AI models can often spot problematic behavior by other AI agents in logs, according to a study by Anthropic researcher Andy Hall.
GPT-5 found about 98 percent of reward-hacking cases, but the more exhaustively the search is tuned, the more false alarms pile up.
That's not yet enough for reliable safety checks.
stories.whyItMatters: 研究上の進展は、次世代モデルや新しい応用領域の実用化につながる可能性があります。
eventTitles: AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms, new study finds

stories.title: The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking

points: In the Vals AI benchmark, OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol Daybreak hits 80.8 percent of attack objectives in simulated corporate networks.
Worse, the open-weight model DeepSeek V4.1 Flash reaches 72.8 percent at a tenth of the cost.
Because open models can no longer be restricted, analysts say the window for defenders is shrinking fast.
